name: Welter
author: Erin Carter
description: A boiling warm color field — molten poles of rust, ember and amber rise and roll through one another with turbulent edges, hot cores glowing brighter as blobs merge. A grainy lava-lamp churn rather than a still gradient.

params.label: Churn speed
params.effect: How vigorously the molten blobs rise and roll; 0 freezes the churn.

params.label: Blob size
params.effect: Influence radius of each pole; low breaks into many small globs, high merges into broad banks.

params.label: Turbulence
params.effect: How much the blob edges roil and tear; 0 gives clean rounded blobs.

params.label: Heat
params.effect: Depth and glow of the hot cores; high deepens the troughs and lights merging blobs.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
